name: parcel-pilot
description: Parcel Pilot — a live demo of CopilotKit's Generative UI spectrum, powered by DHL Developer Portal API schemas. Educational; not affiliated with DHL.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && pip install -r agent/requirements.txt
